sentences.text: Every cable that runs into a sealed machine drags grit in with it, and the usual cure is a shutdown and a pair of tweezers.
sentences.text_raw: Every cable that runs into a sealed machine drags grit in with it, and the usual cure is a shutdown and a pair of tweezers.

sentences.text: This filing claims a way to make the grit stay outside.
sentences.text_raw: This filing claims a way to make the grit stay outside.

sentences.text: The housing does the ordinary thing here: it defines a guide channel that carries the cable through the wall of the enclosure.
sentences.text_raw: The housing does the ordinary thing here: it defines a guide channel that carries the cable through the wall of the enclosure.

sentences.text: What the claim adds sits at the mouth of that channel, a wiper collar that the cable has to pass through on its way in.
sentences.text_raw: What the claim adds sits at the mouth of that channel, a wiper collar that the cable has to pass through on its way in.

sentences.text: The collar is not a seal in the usual sense, because it never grips the cable and never has to be squeezed tight against it.
sentences.text_raw: The collar is not a seal in the usual sense, because it never grips the cable and never has to be squeezed tight against it.

sentences.text: It stands proud of the mouth instead, so the grit riding in on the cable is wiped off outside the wall rather than inside the box.
sentences.text_raw: It stands proud of the mouth instead, so the grit riding in on the cable is wiped off outside the wall rather than inside the box.

sentences.text: Here is the admission tucked into the dependent claim: the collar is an elastomeric sleeve, which is to say a part that is meant to wear.
sentences.text_raw: Here is the admission tucked into the dependent claim: the collar is an elastomeric sleeve, which is to say a part that is meant to wear.

sentences.text: The drawing puts that sleeve on the outer face, where a hand can reach it without opening the enclosure at all.
sentences.text_raw: The drawing puts that sleeve on the outer face, where a hand can reach it without opening the enclosure at all.

sentences.text: So the invention is smaller than the problem it answers, and more candid about itself than most.
sentences.text_raw: So the invention is smaller than the problem it answers, and more candid about itself than most.

sentences.text: It buys back the maintenance stop by admitting up front that one soft part is there to be replaced.
